PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION: Singer’s DLS Turbo Services were first shown to the public at the 2023 Goodwood Festival of Speed. Inspired by the victorious Porsche 934/5 endurance racers of the 1970s, the results brought together the remarkable engine first developed through DLS services with Singer’s expertise in turbocharging, combining the massive low-down torque of forced induction with the ability to rev to 9,000 rpm., Like all Porsche 911s Reimagined by Singer, each DLS Turbo restoration begins life as a 964-generation Porsche 911, which is then sent to Singer’s facilities in the UK to be carefully disassembled and stripped back to the bare chassis. The monocoque is then carefully assessed, strengthened, and further prepared for the additional performance and power to come., At its heart is the Type 964’s M64 3.6-litre flat six-cylinder engine, now expanded to 3.8L and boasting four valves per cylinder, water-cooled cylinder heads, twin turbochargers with electronic wastegates and variable turbine geometry, and air to water intercooling. A further evolution of the engine designed for the DLS services, this turbocharged variant raises output to an astounding 710 bhp (SAE Net) and 750Nm of torque., The sensational carbon fibre bodywork was painstakingly designed using computational fluid dynamics analysis, optimizing aerodynamic performance. It is with the bodywork where the personalization truly begins, and owners can choose between taking a track-focused direction, with larger rear wing and more aggressive front fascia, or a road-focused specification with a rear ducktail spoiler and revised front fascia. For ultimate freedom of choice, both setups could be specified, stored in a set of bespoke flight cases, enabling the owner to change the configuration of their car, as is the case with Sepang., Offered here is “The Sepang Commission”; one of just 99 DLS Turbo restorations. Its first owner, a collector who has commissioned multiple restorations with Singer, spared no expense in the pursuit of a car that epitomizes Singer’s motto of ‘Everything is Important’., Finished in paint to sample Wolf Blue, The Sepang Commission features numerous visible carbon fibre options tinted dark blue to complement the Wolf Blue paintwork. The car’s champagne anodized polished brightwork offers a touch of contrast and this finish is continued on the turbofan magnesium wheels, while the rear decklid badging is specified in solid brass., Inside, The Sepang Commission is trimmed in Bone leather with further champagne anodized and polished brightwork with dark blue-tinted gloss carbon throughout to unify the car’s overall appearance. Touring seats are specified with Bone Alcantara perforated seat centres, seat backs trimmed in soft Bone leather, and ‘DLST’ embossed in the headrests. The outer section of the steering wheel is trimmed in Alcantara to match the bodywork with the inner steering wheel trimmed in bone leather., The Sepang Commission has been outfitted with both the track- and road-focused rear decklid and front fascias, as well as an additional set of clear lens corner lights, allowing its new owner the freedom of choice to configure their new acquisition as required., The Sepang Commission is presented fresh from restoration, with break-in mileage conducted by Singer Vehicle Design before delivery., Unquestionably the wildest and most visually stunning variant of the type-964 Porsche 911 to be reimagined by Singer, the DLS Turbo Services are a spectacular showcase of what this fantastic company is capable of. As one of just 99 restorations, this represents a momentous opportunity to jump the queue and acquire one of the most hotly anticipated vehicles of recent times.

LOT_SUMMARY: Presented as a type-964 Porsche 911 recently restored through Singer’s DLS Turbo Services offered in partnership with Singer Vehicle Design, “The Sepang Commission”, restored for a serial Singer customer with fanatical attention to detail, Offered with both track- and road-focused bodywork configurations, Sepang is one of just 99 DLS Turbo restorations, making this a rare opportunity to immediately acquire a stunning example of Singer’s most ambitious restoration service to date

PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION: A truly sensational specification showing fanatical attention to detail, the Beachland commission is certainly a showcase for Singer Vehicle Design at its very best, exemplifying the company motto: Everything is Important., Completed by Singer Vehicle Design in November of 2023, the Beachland commission boasts the 4.0-liter engine mated to a six-speed manual gearbox and is fitted with the Ohlins sport adjustable suspension alongside carbon ceramic brakes. The car beautifully encapsulates modern performance within its sleek bodywork, boasting seam-welding and a carbon fiber roof in addition to the full carbon fiber bodywork., Outside, the car is finished in paint to sample Beachland paintwork, protected by full paint protection film. Both the raised Porsche lettering and Singer logo are finished in 24 carat gold. The wheels are fitted with Nickel RS wheel centers with a black background, beautifully offsetting the brake calipers, painted in pistachio with black lettering to match the ghosted side stripes., Beachland’s interior is truly a sight to behold, with the focal point being the special wishes carbon track seats. Designed in close collaboration with the consignor over the course of several months, they boast a one-off design with the seats themselves featuring extra-bolstered padding. Designed with long drives in mind, the added padding does not sacrifice the seat’s original track-oriented support, truly making for the best of both worlds. The seat insert upholstery itself is just as unique, a bespoke 12-leather weave designed to complement the exterior colors whilst providing a gentle contrast, and that design is carried through to the dashboard and door panels. In terms of infotainment, the car is fitted with Porsche Classic Navigation, enabled with Apple CarPlay, and the car boasts an upgraded Audison amp, as well as Dynaudio speakers and subwoofer., In addition to the seats, further special wishes options for Beachland include a nickel-plated center console insert and nickel-plated doorsills with ‘Beachland’ script. This script can also be seen on the gauges, modeled in the style of an early 911 and finished in light ivory. The external fuel filler boasts a bespoke Le Mans-inspired design to further differentiate Beachland from other Classic Services. Even the keys were carefully considered, one being a titanium ‘Singer Classic’ key and the other custom designed and color matched to the car with ‘Beachland’ script built by Formawerks. Finally, all of those at Singer Vehicle Design involved with the production of the car signed the underside of the hood., Still under the care of its commissioning owner, the Beachland commission has been driven approximately 5,000 miles since the completion of its reimagining. Offered in partnership between RM Sotheby’s and Singer Vehicle Design, the Beachland commission is offered with a full Singer Vehicle Design warranty, having recently been inspected at Singer’s Torrance, California headquarters., Whilst all Classic Studies are truly unique in their own right, the Beachland commission certainly stands out from its peers, boasting numerous special wishes options and a tasteful, timeless color combination. With Classic Services production now completed, these cars are only becoming more sought after, representing the dawn of Singer Vehicle Design as a brand. The Beachland commission perfectly encapsulates the ethos for that project: a Porsche 911 reimagined to provide modern engineering and performance with classic styling and an exceptional degree of customization, a car to treasure and behold.

LOT_SUMMARY: 4.0-litre engine with six-speed manual gearbox, Ohlins adjustable suspension, and Brembo carbon ceramic brakes, Incredible specification with numerous special wishes options Offered directly by its commissioning owner with approximately 5,000 miles from completion by Singer in November 2023, One of the most highly personalized Classic Studies, Sold in partnership with Singer Vehicle Design, offered with a full warranty
